research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, predict action-conditioned network hydraulics with a differentiable surrogate, optimize 109 writable targets continuously over H120 inside H360, minimize system-wide cumulative TFV, protect Priority8 PFV with a one-sided soft secondary term, and execute only the first 10-minute target in authoritative SWMM
development_priority: learn causal candidate-reference hydraulic trajectories first; treat autograd TFV sensitivity as a downstream diagnostic and online solver signal rather than a primary SWMM-labelled training target

method_identity.rbc_role: warm start, safety fallback, engineering comparator

time_contract.terminal_tail: hold final H120 target through H360

step2_current.architecture: separate temporal-flow dynamics and direct setting-response scales + typed actuator-to-node messages + managed-flow injection + static SWMM edge physics + dynamic head-difference/head-gradient graph messages

step2_current.stage_A0: actuator-only absolute flow fit plus direct same-prefix setting-to-flow magnitude and direction loss
step2_current.stage_A1: authoritative managed-flow injection pretrains flow-to-next-state hydraulic transition; actuator parameters frozen
step2_current.stage_A2: joint teacher forcing with absolute hydraulic fit plus response-weighted direct same-prefix flow/state effects
step2_current.stage_B0: autoregressive truncated trajectory training where full hydraulic feedback effects are permitted
step2_current.stage_B: exact H360 two-pass full within-group TFV pairwise training; no SWMM action-gradient labels
step2_current.gradient_evaluation_order: after direct flow, direct hydraulic, trajectory and ranking checks
step2_current.full_block_reason: counterfactual-first surrogate must pass same-checkpoint direct flow/hydraulic, trajectory/ranking, gradient-diagnostic and Development closed-loop gates

diagnostic_evidence_triggering_repair.new_interpretation: full-horizon teacher-forced flow effect mixes local setting response with branch-specific hydraulic feedback; promotion must use first-divergence common-prefix response plus actuator-balanced summaries

stage_a_stop: A2 joint direct counterfactual teacher forcing

promotion_rule: merge is not scientific promotion. Smoke/dev must first prove causal counterfactual trajectory fidelity and useful ranking; differentiable TFV gradients are then assessed for online solver suitability. Full/D5/runtime/Policy Lock remain disabled until explicit promotion.
